name: AETHER CROWN
source:
Carl is a young boy from the countryside who moves to the city to pursue his dream of becoming an adventurer. He joins Dandelion, the guild he has long admired, only to discover that it has already fallen from its former glory.

Faced with a far harsher reality than he imagined, Carl refuses to give up. AETHER CROWN follows his struggles as he takes on quests, meets new people, and works toward becoming the adventurer he has always dreamed of being.
translation:
卡尔是一名来自乡下的少年，为了追寻成为冒险者的梦想而来到大城市。他如愿加入了仰慕已久的公会“蒲公英”，却发现这里早已不复往日的辉煌。

面对远比想象中残酷的现实，卡尔拒绝轻言放弃。《AETHER CROWN》讲述的正是他接取委托、邂逅伙伴，为成为梦想中的冒险者而一路拼搏奋斗的故事。
